decision_rule: z = (x - standardiser.mean) / standardiser.scale; scores = coefficients @ z + intercepts; proba = softmax(scores); prediction = classes[argmax(proba)]

excluded_features._note: This is not a trained artefact. It is a hand-written four-feature stand-in whose only job is to make the model path of the risk engine reachable in CI, because ml/artifacts/ is gitignored and a fresh checkout has no model.json. Its coefficients were chosen to be monotone in severity and readable by a human; they were not fitted to anything and predict nothing about real driving.

metadata.not_a_model_of: any real vehicle, driver, or corpus
